name: Dead-Air Guard
author: hleawilliams-commits
summary: Warns before the room goes silent: LOAD NEXT, ENDING, QUIET and DEAD AIR, as thin edge bars and one label.
description: Amber LOAD NEXT when every deck you can hear ends within 30 s (adjustable) and no other deck has a different track loaded; red ENDING at 10 s; QUIET when audible decks have been near-silent for 4 s; DEAD AIR if the music stops with the mics off. A deck playing with its channel fader down doesn't count as heard. A mic or TALK OVER switch on silences DEAD/QUIET during speeches. Shows as thin top/bottom bars and one small label, never over the Mod Menu. Read-only: watches the mixer input and each deck's audio level, changes nothing.
